title: The Small box on the shelf
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：small　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 small 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the grower wrote of ① a small box on the shelf in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② smaller than the one named there the year before. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the small ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the smallest box on the shelf anybody in the greenhouse had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too small to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the small ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a small act of kindness, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as small as the act of kindness they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was small or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something small, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite small; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the small ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, before dawn, she wrote of another small box on the shelf in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ smaller than anybody had expected. ⑩ The smallest act of kindness in the whole greenhouse, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the small ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 小（前置定语 a small box on the shelf：1985 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件小的盒子）
B. adj. 小／微不足道（比较级 smaller than：文中两处，一处比架上的小盒子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 小／微不足道（最高级 the smallest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 小（表语 too small to do：母亲觉得它太小，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 微不足道（前置定语 a small act of kindness：叔叔把整件事称作一桩微不足道的善意举动）
F. adj. 微不足道（同级比较 as small as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩一个微不足道的善意举动相比）
G. adj. 微不足道（后置定语 something small：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 微不足道（受程度副词修饰 quite small：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a small box on the shelf
the smallest box on the shelf anybody
The smallest act of kindness in

answers.why: small 意为“小”，1985 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件小的盒子”，此处作前置定语 a small box on the shelf。
small 意为“小”，此处用比较级 smaller than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
small 意为“小”，收成账上 八月 那行字说它是大棚里最小的一件，故用最高级 the smallest box on the shelf。
small 意为“小”，母亲认为这件东西“太小了，谁也用不上”，too small to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
small 意为“微不足道”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩微不足道的善意举动”，此处作前置定语 a small act of kindness。
small 意为“微不足道”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩一个微不足道的善意举动一样微不足道”，同级比较用 as small as。
small 意为“微不足道”，收成账上那半行字要的是“微不足道的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something small。
small 意为“微不足道”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当微不足道”，quite 修饰原级 small。
small 意为“微不足道”，1995 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要微不足道”，故用比较级 smaller than。
small 意为“微不足道”，母亲 1997 年说的是“整个大棚里最微不足道的那一桩”，故用最高级 the smallest act of kindness。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件小的盒子。（a small box on the shelf）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更小。（smaller than …）
母亲觉得它太小，谁也用不上。（too small to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩微不足道的善意举动。（a small act of kindness）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩一个微不足道的善意举动一样微不足道。（as small as …）
到了 1992 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件微不足道的东西。（something small）
answers: In 1985 the grower wrote of a small box on the shelf in the ledger.
Everybody said it was smaller than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too small to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a small act of kindness.
He said nobody would call it as small as the act of kindness they had once had.
By 1992 the ledger asked for nothing but something small.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 small 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the grower wrote of a small box on the shelf in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the smallest box on the shelf in the greenhouse, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too small to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a small act of kindness, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite small, and everybody laughed.
The small ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
